title: Telemetry breadcrumbs handoff brief - panel & rollout
body:
Meeting purpose: quick handoff from panel UI rollout team to telemetry/analytics so instrumentation is final before canary.

Attendees: Priya (owner), Ethan (frontend), Lina (analytics), Marco (platform), Samira (SRE), Grace (product observed asynchronously).

Summary (TL;DR):
- We finished the visual gating for panel rollout (feature flag: panel-v2) and are ready to begin canary tomorrow 2027-02-19 at 10:00 PT.
- Telemetry breadcrumb schema needs one small change (add `panel_variant` field) to properly attribute canary vs control.
- Analytics will run the first 24h QA cohort as an event-level sanity check and a capped aggregation window for latency and error rate.

Key instrument points and decisions:
1) Breadcrumb schema: add `panel_variant` (string enum: control|v2|fallback) + `render_path` (string, short) so we can break down telemetry by micro-frontends (legacy-panel, slot-renderer).
   - Decision: implement `panel_variant` now; `render_path` optional but recommended.
2) Sampling: platform will sample 5% of bg traffic for verbose breadcrumbs (stack traces, props) and 100% of gateway-level summary events (response_time_ms, render_ms, error_code).
   - Rationale: reduce storage while preserving signal for regressions.
3) Latency SLO checks: define two rolling windows for alerts — 1m p50/p95 (for immediate alarms) and 1h p95 (for slow regressions). Thresholds: +15ms p95 for canary to trigger automated rollback.
4) Canary sizing & segmentation: start at 3% traffic for 2 hours, 10% for next 6 hours, then 25% if no triggers. Exclude enterprise reserved customers and EU customers in first pass.

Observed metrics from dev-preview (baseline):
- Baseline page render p95: 210ms (control), p95 in v2 branch on staging: 218ms (+8ms).
- Small jump in frontend JS bundle map size +3.2% (tree-shake pending); runtime impact expected to be <10ms after gzip.
- No functional errors found in unit tests; 2 flaky e2e failures noted (ticketed).

Open risks and questions:
- Q1: If `panel_variant` isn't present (older SDK clients), how do we attribute? Answer: platform proxy will inject header X-Panel-Variant when flagging is applied server-side. Confirmed by Marco.
- Q2: Embedding-level caching interaction — cache miss rates may increase slightly on first rollout; product wants a guardrail. Action: add a jittered warmup cache prefetch at rollout start for top 50 active workspaces.
- Q3: Are we capturing impression -> click chains across micro-frontends? Lina: analytics will stitch session ids for the first 24h QA cohort; longer-term will require a small session sampling job.

Action items (owners and due dates):
- Ethan: add `panel_variant` to client telemetry emitter + bump SDK schema version. Submit PR and link to ENG-2984. Due: 2027-02-18 EOD.
- Marco: ensure the platform proxy will add X-Panel-Variant for server-side flags and document header semantics. Confirm K8s sidecar rollout plan. Due: 2027-02-19 09:00 PT.
- Lina: create the 24h QA cohort dashboard (p50/p95, error_rate, CTR by variant) and a lightweight regression playbook. Add anomaly checks and share with pg. Due: 2027-02-19 12:00 PT.
- Samira: wire alerting thresholds into oncall runbook (pager + slack). Validate rollback automation stub. Due: 2027-02-19 08:00 PT.
- Priya: coordinate canary timeline with product, schedule stakeholder async update and recap. Due: 2027-02-19 09:30 PT.

Post-mortem / measurement plan:
- 0–2h: sanity metrics only (error spikes, JS exceptions). If error_rate > 0.5% absolute over baseline -> abort.
- 2–8h: behavioral metrics (CTR, feature usage). If CTR delta vs control <= -2.0% and statistically significant -> rollback.
- 8–24h: cost metrics (server CPU and render_ms p95) and retention signals for preview cohort.

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Consider a short-lived `panel-experiment` header that is easier for downstream pipelines to filter for experiments.
- Follow-up: small experiment to test aggressive tree-shaking and split-loading of legacy slots to reduce bundle impact.
- Keep an eye on slow clients (older mobile Safari) — instrumentation shows higher tail variance.

References / quick links:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4210
- Jira: ENG-2984 (telemetry schema + canary plan)
- Slack thread: #console-telemetry (pinned messages)

Meeting adjourned: agreed to reconvene after first 2h canary window for a quick triage call if any triggers.

Raw scratch notes:
- TODO: confirm gzip build sizes after CI pipeline runs (artifact available at ci.redwood/artifacts/console-v2/).
- Note: product wants to keep fallback behavior if CPU on dedicated pools spikes — check policy with dedicated infra team.

End of brief.
